question: What is the typical TIM thermal conductivity range for indium foil on a GPU cold plate interface?
answer: Indium foil TIMs are often quoted around 86 W/m·K bulk conductivity, but effective joint resistance depends on bond line thickness and void fraction. For rough power module interfaces, vendor datasheets commonly cite 0.05–0.15 mm BLT with effective R_tim well below grease when voiding is controlled.

sources.title: Indium Corporation, Heat Spring TIM datasheet excerpt
sources.chunk: Indium heat spring and foil series: thermal conductivity 86 W/m·K (bulk). Recommended compression 15–30% for minimum bond line.

sources.title: Internal ATS test report (redacted), GPU cold plate coupon
sources.chunk: Indium foil 0.10 mm BLT measured R_tim = 0.012 °C·cm²/W at 40 psi clamp. Grease baseline 0.019 °C·cm²/W same stack.
